description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the Android Input EventHub, which manages input devices, events, and related hardware features such as batteries, lights, and sensors. It includes class declarations, enums, structs, and method signatures for interacting with input hardware and sysfs components.

classes.name: RawEvent
classes.description: Represents a raw input event with timestamp, device ID, type, code, and value.

classes.name: RawAbsoluteAxisInfo
classes.description: Contains information about an absolute input axis, including min/max values, flat, fuzz, and resolution.

classes.name: EventHubInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface for the input event hub, providing methods for device and event management.

classes.name: BitArray
classes.description: Template class representing a fixed-size bit array with methods for testing bits and loading from buffer.

classes.name: EventHub
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the EventHubInterface, managing input devices, events, and sysfs features.

methods.name: getDeviceClasses
methods.description: Returns the classes of a device given its ID.

methods.name: getDeviceIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of a device given its ID.

methods.name: getDeviceControllerNumber
methods.description: Returns the controller number associated with a device.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration property map for a device.

methods.name: getAbsoluteAxisInfo
methods.description: Gets info about an absolute axis of a device.

methods.name: hasRelativeAxis
methods.description: Checks if a device has a specific relative axis.

methods.name: hasInputProperty
methods.description: Checks if a device has a specific input property.

methods.name: hasMscEvent
methods.description: Checks if a device has a specific MSC event.

methods.name: addKeyRemapping
methods.description: Remaps a key code from one value to another for a device.

methods.name: mapKey
methods.description: Maps a scan code and usage code to a key code and meta state.

methods.name: mapAxis
methods.description: Maps a scan code to axis info.

methods.name: mapSensor
methods.description: Maps an absolute code to a sensor type and index.

methods.name: getRawBatteryIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of batteries associated with a device.

methods.name: getRawBatteryInfo

methods.name: getRawLightIds

methods.name: getRawLightInfo

methods.name: getLightBrightness

methods.name: setLightBrightness

methods.name: getLightIntensities

methods.name: setLightIntensities
methods.description: Sets the color intensities of a light.

methods.name: getRawLayoutInfo
methods.description: Retrieves layout info for a device.

methods.name: setExcludedDevices

methods.name: getScanCodeState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a scan code.

methods.name: getKeyCodeState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a key code.

methods.name: getSwitchState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a switch.

methods.name: getKeyCodeForKeyLocation
methods.description: Gets key code for a specific key location.

methods.name: getAbsoluteAxisValue
methods.description: Gets the current value of an absolute axis.

methods.name: markSupportedKeyCodes
methods.description: Checks support for specific key codes.

methods.name: hasScanCode
methods.description: Checks if a device has a specific scan code.

methods.name: hasKeyCode
methods.description: Checks if a device has a specific key code.

methods.name: hasLed

methods.name: setLedState

methods.name: getVirtualKeyDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves virtual key definitions for a device.

methods.name: getKeyCharacterMap
methods.description: Returns the key character map for a device.

methods.name: setKeyboardLayoutOverlay

methods.name: dump
